scope: Actual packaged WinForms/WebView2 host, exact trusted loopback /remove, owned native dialogs, synthetic QA files only
windowsActions: Use the Computer Use sky APIs in node_repl. Select exactly one returned QA window, observe and inspect, perform one action, refresh. NativeQaWindow supports only capabilities, windows and read-only inspect metadata. It has no resize, close, invoke, select, expand or text-input commands; all actual Windows inputs use the separately authorized Computer Use session.
preconditions: Rebuild the final package and verify its frontend files against current frontend_dist.
Choose a new qa-artifacts run folder, generate synthetic fixtures and record package hashes.
Confirm port 51247 and the chosen loopback CDP port are unused; never terminate another app to acquire them.
Launch only the exact recorded package with its own profile and process-local debugging arguments.
Check backend profile, trusted /remove target, executable/PID/start-time identity and loopback-only debug listener before attaching.
Select only the returned QA app/window, or an owned native modal whose owner chain reaches that QA window. Stop on ambiguity or a locked desktop.

scenarios.name: native-ready-open-cancel
steps: Observe the actual app
Invoke File Open from the visible UI
Observe the owned Windows picker and record ownership
Cancel it
Verify no session/file changes, app responsive and no false success or timeout message

scenarios.name: open-files
steps: Open the native file picker
Enter one generated PNG path inside fixtureRoot using an observed filename edit
Confirm Open
Verify document name/dimensions and native Save availability in the actual WebView

scenarios.name: open-folder
steps: Open the native folder picker
Inspect its actual controls; use observed Computer Use controls to select fixtureRoot
Confirm
Verify both synthetic images and per-image navigation

scenarios.name: open-project
steps: Open the native project picker
Select the synthetic v1 .lremove fixture
Confirm
Verify project reopens and source-overwrite authority is unavailable

scenarios.name: project-save-cancel-complete-save-as
steps: Make one reversible synthetic layer edit
Choose Save Project
Cancel the owned Save As picker
Verify project remains unsaved and no expected file exists
Repeat and save inside exportRoot
Verify successful UI state plus a real non-empty .lremove file and SHA256
Choose Save Project As, save to a second unique QA path, verify both files persist

scenarios.name: native-download
steps: Export the synthetic edited image
Observe the actual host-owned native Save As download dialog
Cancel once and verify no completed output claim
Repeat and save inside exportRoot
Verify final file existence, bytes, SHA256 and decoding; download-start alone is not success

scenarios.name: multi-document-close-cancel
steps: Open both generated images and make distinct reversible edits
Request Close on the actual app window
Observe its pending-edit/project review
Choose Cancel
Verify the same host process remains, both documents and edits remain, and no forced close occurs

scenarios.name: long-open-owned-picker
steps: Observe an owned native picker
Keep it open for at least 610 seconds while other independent checks continue
Use a bounded read-only background observer of only the QA process/window; do not inject input or force close
Re-observe and Cancel or confirm the original picker
Verify its reply still routes correctly, no ten-minute timeout error, and app remains usable

scenarios.name: window-and-text-matrix
steps: Resize only the QA app window using targeted Computer Use
Measure actual WebView innerWidth/innerHeight through loopback CDP
Capture 800x560, 1366x768 and a large desktop viewport when reachable
Set Large/200% text through the app's own Settings
Capture actual WebView content plus native-window screenshots
Record current DPI/devicePixelRatio; do not claim untested DPI levels or change global OS scaling

evidenceRules: Never log launcher keys, browser tokens, headers, request bodies or token-containing HTML.
Native-window screenshots and actual WebView content captures are distinct evidence; CDP screenshots exclude owned dialogs.
Record pending/blocked explicitly when controls, ownership, rendering or completion cannot be verified.
No GPU/model jobs, provider searches, software installers, publishing or personal files.
No app-host code, navigation allowlist, message allowlist, registry or global DPI changes.
